**Bottom line:** these are the public websites the course points to for looking up blockchain activity. Each link
opens the site's own page, outside the course. They are for awareness and practice on public data; the course labs use
open-source tools only. Some of the sites are run by companies. Every link answered when checked [12 Nov 2026]{.asof}.

## Bitcoin

- [mempool.space](https://mempool.space)
- [Blockstream explorer](https://blockstream.info)
- [Blockchain.com explorer](https://www.blockchain.com/explorer)
- [WalletExplorer](https://walletexplorer.com)

## Ethereum and EVM chains

- [Etherscan](https://etherscan.io)
- [BscScan](https://bscscan.com)
- [Arbiscan](https://arbiscan.io)
- [Basescan](https://basescan.org)
- [Polygonscan](https://polygonscan.com)

## Other chains

- [Tronscan](https://tronscan.org)
- [Solscan](https://solscan.io)

## Many chains in one

- [Blockchair](https://blockchair.com)
- [OKLink](https://www.oklink.com)

- [OFAC Sanctions List Search](https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov)
- [Chainabuse](https://www.chainabuse.com)
- [CryptoScamDB](https://cryptoscamdb.org)
